title: Writing / Style
slide_intent: Choose editorial conventions for usability so readers encounter clear, predictable language.
strategic_value: A stated preference for user-friendliness over formal convention can help Duolingo make consistent decisions in small pieces of copy.
demonstration: The blue style introduction pairs a usability statement with oversized colorful punctuation marks.
practical_value: Evaluate a style decision by how easily a learner can read and use it.

content_islands.name: Section introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the Writing label, lowercase section title and explanatory paragraph at left on the blue field.

content_islands.name: Illustrated cue

reference_purposes.Intent: The paragraph says grammar and style rules are based on usability rather than always following formal convention.
